desc: Implement the lazy segment tree initialized with \(f(x)=x\), supporting range addition, maximum-threshold lower-bound search, and point queries.
Process each contest by updating the indices in the preimage of \([L_i,R_i]\), correctly handling empty ranges and absent thresholds.
Process queries and verify the implementation against all three samples and the stated complexity \(O((N+Q)\log 500000)\).
